name: Moonglade
summary: This quest marks a young tauren druid's introduction to Moonglade, the sacred sanctuary of Cenarion druidism. Guided by Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, the initiate learns to traverse the waking world to commune directly with nature's ancient keepers.

sections.title: A Sacred Haven Beyond Faction
sections.body: Moonglade stands apart from the turbulent politics of Kalimdor. Sheltered beneath primeval boughs and watched over by Keeper Remulos, the son of Cenarius, this ancient valley is a neutral refuge for all who walk the path of nature. Whether night elf or tauren, any druid who enters Nighthaven does so as an equal peer under the timeless mantle of the Cenarion Circle.

sections.title: The Leap Across Kalimdor
sections.body: To aid your spiritual and martial development, Turak Runetotem teaches you a unique transport spell tied to the valley itself. By invoking the mystic bond between druids and the natural world, you step across hundreds of leagues in a heartbeat. This sanctuary will serve as both a study hall and an enduring refuge throughout your journey.

sections.title: Awakening the Bear
sections.body: Upon arriving in Nighthaven, you meet Dendrite Starblaze, an elder night elf druid awaiting new pupils. Under his guidance, the first true trial of your calling begins: seeking the perspective of the bear. Embracing the ways of the Claw requires proving one's strength, courage, and balance before the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Why can tauren visit a night elf haven like Moonglade?
faq.answer: Moonglade is sovereign sacred ground under the Cenarion Circle, guided by Keeper Remulos. Within its borders, devotion to nature and Cenarius completely supersedes the faction conflict between the Horde and the Alliance, permitting tauren and night elf druids to train and dwell alongside one another in peace.

Dendrite Starblaze is an elder night elf druid stationed in the settlement of Nighthaven. He mentors newly arrived initiates of both races, administering their early trials as they attune to the ancient animal aspects.

Keeper Remulos is a mighty Keeper of the Grove and son of the demigod Cenarius. He serves as the supreme guardian of Moonglade, watching over the sacred barrows where sleeping druids hibernate and ensuring the sanctity of the valley remains inviolate.

Speaking with Dendrite Starblaze begins your trial with the Great Bear Spirit. He sends you into the wild lands to commune with the spirit and overcome a test of strength, ultimately unlocking the secrets of the bear form.

faq.q: How does Teleport: Moonglade work lore-wise?
faq.answer: Druids weave natural ley energies and their spiritual connection to the Cenarion Circle to instantly bridge the distance between wherever they stand and the heart of Moonglade. It serves as a spiritual anchor, letting them return for instruction and solace whenever summoned.
Turak Runetotem resides atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, mentoring young tauren who heed the call of the wild before sending them onward to Moonglade.

angles.text: This rite of passage bridges the distance between traditional tribal beliefs and the broader tenets of the Cenarion Circle, opening the door to ancient shapeshifting forms.
For tauren initiates, arriving in Moonglade is a profound awakening: proof that their ancient ties to the Earth Mother align deeply with the teachings of Cenarius.
Though tensions simmer across Kalimdor, Horde druids find Moonglade to be one of the rare places in the world where they can cross paths peacefully with their night elf counterparts.
